description: This file defines the Perl package 'Git::SVN::Fetcher', which implements a subclass of SVN::Delta::Editor. It provides callback methods to process Subversion tree deltas, track changes, and manage metadata for use by 'git svn fetch'. The code includes methods for handling files, directories, properties, and placeholders, as well as integration with git objects and repository management.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Fetcher
classes.description: A Perl module implementing a Subversion delta consumer for 'git svn fetch', tracking changes and metadata for repositories.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the Fetcher object with repository configuration.

methods.name: _mark_empty_symlinks
methods.description: Internal method to identify empty symbolic links in the repository history.

methods.name: in_dot_git
methods.description: Checks if a given path is inside a '.git' directory.

methods.name: is_path_ignored
methods.description: Determines if a path should be ignored based on ignore and include regexes.

methods.name: set_path_strip
methods.description: Sets a prefix to be stripped from file paths during processing.

methods.name: open_root
methods.description: Returns a representation for the root directory.

methods.name: open_directory
methods.description: Returns a representation for an opened directory.

methods.name: git_path
methods.description: Converts a repository-specific path to a git-compatible path, applying encoding and path stripping.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.description: Handles deletion of a file or directory at a given path and revision.

methods.name: open_file
methods.description: Handles opening a file at a specified path and revision, determining its mode and blob ID.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Handles adding a new file at a specified path, setting mode and other attributes.

methods.name: add_directory
methods.description: Handles adding a new directory, managing placeholders and empty directory flags.

methods.name: change_dir_prop
methods.description: Records a change to directory properties.

methods.name: absent_directory
methods.description: Records a directory that could not be conveyed, e.g., due to permissions.

methods.name: absent_file
methods.description: Records a file that could not be conveyed.

methods.name: change_file_prop
methods.description: Handles changes to file properties such as executable or special mode.

methods.name: apply_textdelta
methods.description: Prepares to apply a text delta, creating temporary files for processing.

methods.name: close_file
methods.description: Finalizes a file after delta application, computes the object hash, and updates index.

methods.name: abort_edit
methods.description: Handles cleanup on aborting an edit session.

methods.name: close_edit
methods.description: Finalizes changes, including handling empty directories and placeholders.

methods.name: find_empty_directories
methods.description: Finds and returns a list of directories that are now empty due to deletions.

methods.name: add_placeholder_file
methods.description: Creates a placeholder file in an empty directory to preserve directory existence.

methods.name: stash_placeholder_list
methods.description: Saves the list of added placeholders into repository config.
